c2_bad.why: A grey-scale ISA-101 industrial HMI direction (alarms the only saturated colour, gloves, trend sparklines, confirm-and-hold) promoted to core with lexical 0.0 for a green-branded consumer pharmacy kiosk with an EN/ES black-yellow accessible mode; following it would restyle the whole product for a timeout fix with change_budget low.
Nothing in the identify step or the idle dialog conveys status by colour alone; selected purely for 'required coverage: no colour alone for status'.

why: The c1 root failure is gone: platform is now kiosk, so comp-kiosk-keypad, kiosk-public-use and a11y-time-and-auto (the exact 'timeouts warn and allow extension; kiosks show a visible countdown' rule, plus polite live region on the value and 'focus never falls to the page body') replace web-responsive-breakpoints, nav-wizard and surface-flat-tonal, the two forbidden adaptive.* concepts are no longer delivered, privacy.shared_device / a11y.live_status / touch.minimum_target / interaction.focus_restore are now covered, and the direction dropped the unjustified density-high slot.
